title: Roof Replacement in Estacada, OR
summary: In August 2025, French Roofing replaced the shingle roof on a home in Estacada, OR. The crew tore the old brown shingles off down to the deck, laid new underlayment, and installed gray CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles with new ridge cap, roof vents and pipe flashings.
scope: Tore off the old shingles down to the roof deck
Installed new underlayment, drip edge and starter shingles
Installed new CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles
Capped the ridges and hips with new ridge cap shingles
New roof vents and new flashing boots around the plumbing vent pipes

faqs.question: What shingles went on this Estacada roof?
faqs.answer: CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles in gray, replacing the old brown shingles, with new ridge cap on the ridges and hips.
